description.en: EBench is a simulation benchmark for diagnosing generalist mobile manipulation policies. It comprises 26 manipulation tasks annotated along five capability dimensions (scene, atomic skill, horizon, precision, mobility) and four generalization dimensions (object, background, instruction, mixed), with strict train/test splits and held-out online evaluation.
